item.text: I’m reviewing the current structure to find the next real simplification point instead of just renaming things. The main candidate now is insertion: it still carries a bespoke `InsertResult` wrapper purely to move one boolean up the recursion.

I’m refactoring the balancing internals now so node-specific state lives with `Node` instead of being manipulated through separate utility methods. That should simplify rotation/rebalance code and remove several low-cohesion helpers.
One follow-up edit is still needed because the insertion path was using the old height helper directly. I’m fixing that and then compiling the result.
The internal cohesion refactor is complete. I’m compiling and running the demo now to confirm the node-centric balancing code preserved behavior.
I’ve verified the behavior stayed stable. I’m grabbing line numbers now so the summary can point at the node-level balancing changes precisely.

Further refactored the balancing internals in [AVLTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/044_avl_tree_insertion/AVLTree.java:18) so node-specific invariants live on `Node` itself instead of being spread across tree-level helpers.

The main change is that `Node` now owns `leftHeight()`, `rightHeight()`, `balanceFactor()`, and `refreshHeight()` ([AVLTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/044_avl_tree_insertion/AVLTree.java:29)). That let me simplify `rebalance`, `rotateLeft`, `rotateRight`, and the post-insert fixup to operate in terms of node behavior directly ([AVLTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/044_avl_tree_insertion/AVLTree.java:170), [AVLTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/044_avl_tree_insertion/AVLTree.java:179), [AVLTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/044_avl_tree_insertion/AVLTree.java:229)). The old tree-level `updateHeight` and `getBalanceFactor` helpers are gone; only the null-safe static `height(...)` remains as shared support.

Verification: `javac AVLTree.java AVLTreeDemo.java` succeeded, and `java AVLTreeDemo` still prints `30 20 10 25 40 50`.
